summary:
Comprehensive architectural plan to solve Atrium's 7.2MB monolithic bundle issue:
- Replaces 116 top-level static screen imports in App.tsx with dynamic React.lazy imports grouped into 16 category-dedicated chunks (category-membership, category-medical, category-contractor, category-garage, etc.).
- Configures Vite rollup manualChunks for vendor caching (vendor-react, vendor-motion, vendor-icons, vendor-supabase).
- Integrates existing StructuralSkeletons into React Suspense boundaries for zero-CLS, instant category-matched wireframe transitions.
- Converts heavy printable engines (SFP 01, Decomptes, Weighbridge, Ordonnance) and global modals to on-demand lazy imports.
- Anticipates a 93%+ initial bundle reduction from 7.2MB to ~380-480kB.
